title: About Dra. Gabriella González Pane
subtitle: Twenty years of conservative dentistry, written plans, and honest second opinions — in Spanish and English.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: Dra. Gabriella González Pane graduated around 2005 from the Universidad Autónoma del Paraguay. Since then she has built her practice on one rule: evaluate before acting. Over two decades she has treated thousands of patients, with a focus on restorative dentistry, endodontics, aesthetic care, and second-opinion reviews. English-language care for international patients has been part of her work for years.

sections.heading: Clinical philosophy
items: Conservative-first: preserve healthy tooth structure whenever possible.
No overtreatment: she will tell you when work isn’t needed.
Transparent pricing: published prices and written quotes.
Honest referrals: if specialization is required, she coordinates it.
Quality materials: German composite and premium laboratory work.
Written planning: every case reviewed before any irreversible step.

sections.heading: Experience
bullets: ~20 years in general and conservative dentistry.
~130 patients per month at current practice.
Complex cases: restorations, endodontics, aesthetic dentistry.
English proficiency: regular international patient base.

sections.heading: Outside the chair
sections.body: She lives in Luque and is building a practice focused on patients who want clarity over pressure. Her goal is to create a calm, transparent space where expats and local families can get honest assessment, written plans, and reliable treatment — without the rush and overtreatment common in volume-driven clinics.
